padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for padding inline (MarsUI 96px md textarea: 12px ink inset).

padding-block.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for padding block (MarsUI 96px md textarea: 12px ink inset).

label-gap.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for label gap.

label-padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for label padding inline (MarsUI Input_label row 2px inset aligning the label ink with the cell radius; matches ki-input).

hint-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for the hint row foreground (MarsUI Hint_label Text/med_em; the hint row itself is pending its founder-gated API addition).

radius.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for radius (MarsUI Radius/component/radius_md 10px for the md size; component ramp so personality modes reach it).

min-target.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for min target.

font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for font size.

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the textarea component for font weight.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for line height.

label-font-size.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for label font size (MarsUI UI/Para/medium: body_1 13px).

label-font-weight.$description: font weight used by the textarea component for label font weight.

label-line-height.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for label line height (MarsUI line_height/para 20px).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for border width (MarsUI 1px hairline; the border color stays ki.outline.control per the declared a11y deviation).

border-block-start-width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for border block start width.

border-block-end-width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for border block end width.

border-inline-start-width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for border inline start width.

border-inline-end-width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for border inline end width.

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for rest background (MarsUI textarea fill Surface/s2).

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for rest foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for rest border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for rest label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state; matches ki-input).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for rest placeholder foreground (MarsUI placeholder Text/low_em; placeholder is not the accessible name, so it sits outside the 4.5:1 text sweep).

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for hover background (MarsUI hover = s2 + Black/3 overlay; s3 is the nearest token).

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for hover foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for hover border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for hover label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state; matches ki-input).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for hover placeholder foreground (MarsUI placeholder Text/low_em; placeholder is not the accessible name, so it sits outside the 4.5:1 text sweep).

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus background (MarsUI active fill switches to white / dark s2 — modeled with the scheme ladder s0).

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state; matches ki-input).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus placeholder foreground (MarsUI placeholder Text/low_em; placeholder is not the accessible name, so it sits outside the 4.5:1 text sweep).

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for disabled background (MarsUI Surface/disabled_base_em Gray/100; aligned with ki-input).

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for disabled foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for disabled border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for disabled label foreground.

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for disabled placeholder foreground.

hint-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for the disabled hint row foreground (MarsUI disabled ladder Text/base_em; disabled cells are exempt from the contrast sweep).

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for readonly background.

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for readonly foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for readonly border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for readonly label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state; matches ki-input).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for readonly placeholder foreground (MarsUI placeholder Text/low_em; placeholder is not the accessible name, so it sits outside the 4.5:1 text sweep).

bg.$description: color used by the textarea component for invalid background (MarsUI danger keeps the white active fill — no tinted slab; ring and hint carry the signal).

fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for invalid foreground.

border.$description: color used by the textarea component for invalid border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for invalid label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state; matches ki-input).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for invalid placeholder foreground (MarsUI placeholder Text/low_em; placeholder is not the accessible name, so it sits outside the 4.5:1 text sweep).

ring.$description: shadow used by the textarea component for the persistent invalid ring (MarsUI Focus/danger: 3px danger-500 alpha spread; applied as box-shadow while :state(user-invalid)).

hint-fg.$description: color used by the textarea component for the invalid hint row foreground (MarsUI Hint_label danger: Text/danger_high_em carries the signal).

color.$description: color used by the textarea component for focus ring color.

width.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for focus ring width.

offset.$description: dimension used by the textarea component for focus ring offset.

shadow.$description: shadow used by the textarea component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).
